$name: Tempo brand tokens v2.1, Signal with light
$note: Dark-first. Contrast is against the canvas of each mode. v2.1 (4 Oct 2026): Ink canvas, website grain and section lights, button hover glow, lit cards. Options and reasoning in landing-lab.html.
$sources: Raycast (type, surface ladder, white pill), Linear (graphite and indigo), Vercel (mono labels, glow restraint)

canvas.$was: #08090B until v2.1. The indigo tint keeps it dark without reading as flat black

accent.$use: links, focus, mark tile, chart series 1. Never put text on it (white is 3.4:1)

pill-ink.$use: text on the white pill. Stays graphite, not the Ink canvas

on-accent.$use: text and icons on the accent-strong fill (5.0:1)

tint-status.$use: status chip fill: color-mix(status, canvas). On Ink the lowest is accent at 5.1:1, then risk at 5.7:1

accent.$use: also the indigo button, white text 5.8:1

stale-fill.$use: chart fills only, always with a label (2.95:1)

on-accent.$use: text and icons on the accent fill (5.8:1)

tint-status.$use: status chip fill on light. Higher tints drop risk text below 4.5:1

project.$validated: dataviz validate_palette.js, 3 Oct 2026, surfaces #08090B and #FFFFFF, adjacent pairs in order slate, violet, blue, teal, green, amber, rose. Passes lightness band, CVD separation (worst adjacent 9.8 dark, 9.4 light), normal-vision floor (15.8 dark, 15.5 light) and 3:1 contrast. Chroma floor fails for slate only (OKLCH C 0.042 dark, 0.045 light): slate is the neutral project colour and is meant to read as grey; it always sits beside the project name.

dataviz.$validated: dataviz validate_palette.js, 3 Oct 2026: categorical passes all checks in both modes; status fills pass CVD separation
dataviz.rules: one axis, 2px lines, 4px rounded bar ends, 2px gaps, legend for 2+ series, hover readout and table view on every chart, status always with icon and label

glow.hero: radial-gradient(40% 50% at 30% 30%, rgba(124,124,255,.22), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(35% 45% at 70% 40%, rgba(34,211,238,.14), transparent 70%)

section-light.$use: website only. One per section after the hero, alternating sides and colours, drifting on motion.ambient

grain.value: white fractal noise (feTurbulence baseFrequency .9, 3 octaves) at 4.5%, fixed over the page
grain.$use: website, dark only. Never in the app

button-primary-hover.light: same shape at half alpha under the ink pill
button-primary-hover.shine: linear-gradient(110deg, transparent 38%, rgba(124,124,255,.30) 50%, transparent 62%), 260% wide, swept once across on hover-in

glow.button-secondary-hover: edge hairline to rgba(255,255,255,.34), inner radial-gradient(110px circle at cursor, rgba(124,124,255,.30), transparent 70%)

lit-card.tone: flag colour: the app's colour for that flag: stale = duplicate (medium flag), risk = no owner and exposed key (both high), data = digest
lit-card.wash: radial-gradient(620px circle at cursor or 18% 0, color-mix(tone N%, transparent), transparent 70%)
lit-card.edge: 1px masked ring, radial-gradient(420px circle at cursor or 18% 0, tone, transparent 65%)
lit-card.lamp: 1px line across the top from 14% to 86%, transparent → tone → transparent, with a soft bloom
lit-card.$rule: colour always means the flag. Never above the hover strengths

glow.$rule: No gradients on text. The only glow on a button is the primary hover

sans.$load: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/inter-ui@4/inter-variable.css (official build). Google Fonts and Fontsource strip the stylistic sets, so ss03 does nothing there

mono.$use: repo paths, hashes, branches, eyebrows only

motion.word-reveal: 700ms per word, 45ms stagger, from translateY(.45em) and blur(8px), once per visit
motion.card-light-sequence: 500ms between cards, starts when a card is half visible, lit transition 900ms
motion.$rule: every section moves, but only one story moment per section; everything else enters once and holds still
motion.reduced: final frame, no loops, no drift, lit cards start lit

logo.$mark: One beat (4 Oct 2026), replacing the metronome needle

motion.draw: 900ms left to right, cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1), on load and when a sync lands
